description: The record of the experiments your coding agents run, as Rabbit Brain YAML files in your repo: questions, experiments with their hypothesis, variants and criteria, runs with receipts, and the resources they used. Agents record; rb checks and computes findings; you decide. Documentation: rb docs. New here? Run rb tour.
